```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(biobakeryUtils)
suppTabIndex <- 1
outdir <- "Supplementary Tables"
dir.create(outdir)
```

## Supplementary Table `r suppTabIndex` - step by step feature and sample exclusions

```{r}
invisible(file.copy("~/parkinsonMetaAnalysis_data/03-analysis_ready_datasets/00-filtering-steps.tsv", sprintf("%s/Table S%s - step by step feature and sample exclusions.tsv", outdir, suppTabIndex)))

suppTabIndex <- suppTabIndex + 1
          
```

## Supplementary Table `r suppTabIndex` - studies included in the analyses

```{r}
# use this for a richer source of info
# https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ASAP-MAC/parkinsons_data_search/refs/heads/main/parkinson_shotgun_datasets.tsv

input.tse <- read_TSE_from_dir("~/parkinsonMetaAnalysis_data/03-analysis_ready_datasets/01-dataset_complete-MetaPhlAn.tse/")
  
# extract colData
input.df <- as.data.frame(colData(input.tse))

datasets_accessions <- input.df %>% select(study_name, BioProject) %>% distinct()

# fix Asnicar's missing dataset accession
invisible(file.copy("~/parkinsonMetaAnalysis_data/03-analysis_ready_datasets/00-filtering-steps.tsv", sprintf("%s/Table S%s - step by step feature and sample exclusions.tsv", outdir, suppTabIndex)))

suppTabIndex <- suppTabIndex + 1
```
